This [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] '''individual''' served as the [[Trade monarch/Legends|trade monarch]], ruler of [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] and its [[Purse world/Legends|purse worlds]]: [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], [[Deko Neimoidia/Legends|Deko Neimoidia]], and [[Koru Neimoidia/Legends|Koru Neimoidia]], during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]], the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], kept in contact with the trade monarch via [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] communications within the Trade Federation delegation offices in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]].<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Episode I">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref>
